decisions.reason: Message 279 establishes that the FAQ applies to both iOS and Android, but the Android Requirement already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording FAQ localization through app strings.
Representing FAQ content as localizable app strings does not necessarily change the current iOS download-size optimization strategy or attributes.
The source concerns localization of FAQ content, not delivery or presentation of the separate How-To-Use video.
Localizing the Android FAQ through app strings does not necessarily alter the Android package-size goal, asset strategy, or optimization priority.
